yacl3.config.slotplus:config.title: SlotPlus
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.enabled.des: Master switch for the bind gesture and the swap triggers. On by default.
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.hotbarShift: Shift-clicking a bound hotbar slot swaps it with its bound partner instead of moving the item to the main inventory. Off by default.
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.creativeSup: Also allow binding and swapping while the creative inventory is open. Swaps there use the exact clicks of a manual number-key hotbar swap in creative. Takes effect the next time the inventory is opened. Off by default.
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.keybindNote: The bind key can be rebound in Options > Controls > Key Binds.
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.showTutoria: Tick to see the binding tutorial again the next time you open your inventory. It unticks itself once the tutorial has been shown.
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.showPartner: Show hotbar numbers on bound slots
Draw the paired hotbar slot's number on top of each bound slot. On by default.
slotplus.tutorial.title: SlotPlus
slotplus.tutorial.line1: Hold [%s] and click an inventory slot to start a bind.
slotplus.tutorial.line2: Then click (or drag and release over) a partner slot to finish.
slotplus.tutorial.line3: Middle-click a bound slot to swap it with its bound partner.
